_comment: Placeholder content overlay. The real values live in content.local.json (git-ignored). library_root is the folder holding the media library. Evolver and Origenerator read the same key from their own overlays and the three must agree. main_player_status_file is optional: the full path to Fun Time's main_player_status.txt (in its state_dir), the file the main player publishes what it is playing into -- it lets the launcher prefill a new session from whatever the main player is showing, and omitting it simply opens the launcher blank.
